sloka: स्मितं कृत्वा तु वैदेही रामं वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।तपोवनानि पुण्यानि द्रष्टुमिच्छामि राघव ।। ७.४२.३२ ॥
transliteration: smitaṁ kṛtvā tu vaidehī rāmaṁ vākyamathābravīt ।tapovanāni puṇyāni draṣṭumicchāmi rāghava ।। 7.42.32 ॥

translations.english: Rama asked Sita, "O one with beautiful thighs, what do you desire? What wish of yours may I fulfill?" Then, smiling, Vaidehi spoke these words to Rama.
